text: I've used this app, and i Genuinely love this app. It's clean, simple, and doesn't overwhelm. It's exactly what i needed to organize my daily routine without clutter. Highly recommend if you want a no-nonsense habit tracker!!!

text: Habit Book is really nice habit tracking app. The app is very clean and simple to use—no confusing things, just what I need to stay focused every day. I like the streak tracker a lot, and it feels so good when I tick a habit as done. Features request - maybe add habit sharing, so that 2 or more people can track habits together and stay consistent.
author: chetan kumar
developer_reply: Thank you! We're so glad you find Habit Book clean and simple. It's rewarding to hear the streak tracker is motivating. We love the habit sharing idea and have added it to our feature roadmap. Your feedback helps us make the app even better!
